game.name: F1 Race Stars (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Pl)
game.desc: F1 Race Stars is a racing game for Xbox 360. The player can play as all the drivers of the 2012 Formula 1 season and drive around revamped circuits with loops, jumps and other shortcuts. Various power-ups are also included, including heat-seeking bullets, boosts, missiles, and a safety car that slows down the leader.
